Trả JSON đúng dạng: {reply:string,summary?:string,actions:array}. actions chỉ được lead.upsert, notification.create, handoff.request.' }, { role: 'user', content: JSON.stringify($json.context) }] } }}

parameters.jsCode: const source=$('Validate Event').item.json; const raw=$json.choices?.[0]?.message?.content; const out=typeof raw==='string'?JSON.parse(raw):raw; if(!out||typeof out.reply!=='string'||!Array.isArray(out.actions)) throw new Error('INVALID_AI_OUTPUT'); const allowed=new Set(['lead.upsert','notification.create','handoff.request']); out.actions=out.actions.filter(a=>allowed.has(a?.type)).slice(0,5); const command={schemaVersion:'1.0',eventId:crypto.randomUUID(),correlationId:source.eventId,command:'chat.reply',sessionId:source.batch.sessionId,batchId:source.batch.id,expectedVersion:source.batch.sessionVersion,payload:{content:out.reply,attachments:[],metadata:{summary:out.summary||null,actions:out.actions}}}; return [{json:{command,callbackUrl:source.callbackUrl}}];

const crypto=require('crypto'); const raw=JSON.stringify($json.command); const timestamp=String(Date.now()); const secret=$env.N8N_INBOUND_SECRET||$env.N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET; const signature=crypto.createHmac('sha256',secret).update(timestamp+raw).digest('hex'); return [{json:{...$json,raw,timestamp,signature}}];
